items.title: Kering turnaround hopes hit by drop in Gucci sales
items.summary: Philippine business desk reports Gucci Q3 sales fell 6% comparable to EUR1.29bn on weak China and Japan footfall; direct retail sales down 9%. CEO Luca de Meo presses a five-year margin plan while accelerating store closures (105 done, 125 planned by year-end). Independent earnings-critical coverage, not Gucci-owned content.

items.title: How the third quarter shows luxury industry can't rely on walk-ins anymore
items.summary: Regional trade-press analysis of Q3 luxury results uses Gucci as the lead example of a footfall-dependent brand struggling in APAC (comparable sales -6%, direct retail -9%) while client-relationship-driven peers like Hermes and Zegna outperform; frames Gucci's APAC weakness as a structural retail-model problem, not just China cyclicality. Independent, analytically critical.

items.title: Penjualan Gucci Anjlok, Saham Induknya Ikut Terjun Bebas
items.summary: Indonesian business outlet reports Gucci Q3 2026 revenue fell 6% to EUR1.291bn, worse than analyst forecasts; direct retail/e-commerce sales down 9% y/y on weak China and Japan demand; Kering shares fell 10.7% on the print. Notes jewelry (+11%) and eyewear (+4%) offsetting Gucci's drag. Neutral-analytical tone but centers Gucci's negative momentum for an Indonesian audience.

items.title: Gucci Visions debuts at EMSPHERE, Bangkok
items.summary: Purely descriptive write-up of the Gucci Visions pop-up heritage exhibition opening at EMSPHERE mall in Bangkok, covering six themed rooms tracing a century of design and over 200 handbag variations. Brand-staged activation with no independent evaluative verdict from the outlet.
items.activation_note: Descriptive write-up of brand-staged exhibition; no outlet verdict -> sentiment-rubric activation discount applies (neutral/0 unless classifier finds an evaluative line).

items.title: Demna's Gucci S/S27 Review: "The Store Show," Explained
items.summary: SEA-facing fashion outlet's review of Demna's SS27 Gucci show ('The Store Show') concludes he found the sweet spot between commercial appeal and his own point of view, praising 'expensive swagger'. Reads as celebratory/promotional rather than rigorous critique: one-sided positive framing, little analytical distance; flagged as activation-adjacent despite being third-party press, not a Gucci house channel. Outside strict 7-day window but kept for SEA runway-reaction context given thin same-week supply; capped influence given age.

items.title: Gucci SS27 Show - PurseForum discussion thread
items.summary: Community thread (started by a moderator, ongoing replies) discussing Demna's SS27 show: described as 'very commercial' with ready-to-wear 'also worked as advertorial'; mixed reaction - liked the attitude/styling, felt no standout pieces though would consider a pagoda-shoulder jacket and pencil skirt; one commenter judged it more memorable than the prior season but questioned pricing on a blazer. Genuine independent consumer/collector opinion, mixed-to-lukewarm. Outside strict freshness window (thread opened late Sept) but kept as the clearest SEA-reachable community read on the new collection given thin same-week supply; direct fetch blocked by site (403), content via search snippet only.

items.title: Warehouses full of fake Gucci, Dior, Hermes goods busted in Vietnam crackdown
items.summary: Background/context item on a recurring theme: Vietnamese police crackdown uncovered multi-stage counterfeit networks (retail, warehouses, social commerce, manufacturing workshops) producing and selling fake Gucci, Dior, Hermes, Nike and other goods, including a Ho Chi Minh City workshop making 23,000+ fake sandals. Outside the 14-day freshness window - included only as background context on sustained counterfeit-image risk in the Vietnam market, not counted toward today's fresh-item total.
